The Blood of Dawnwalker - Official Opening Cinematic
recentItems.description: Watch the Opening Cinematic for The Blood of Dawnwalker, a third-person action RPG developed by Revel Wolves. Players can get a look at where the story begins through the Opening Cinematic as Black Death scours the lands in 14th-century Europe. The Blood of Dawnwalker is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).

recentItems.title: NBA 2K27 Review
recentItems.description:
NBA 2K27 reviewed by Nico Vergara on PC, also available on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2.

"NBA 2K27 is a reflection of the budding prospect who couldn’t quite put things together. Sure, it made a splash at first, with a smooth on-court experience that’s better than in recent years, but it fails to follow that up with anything meaningful. A middling MyCareer story doesn’t help its case and flawed new modes, like MyCareer Eras and MyNBA Legacy, only worsen things by highlighting long-running problems. It’s a tale as old as time, a clichéd one that starts with “what if,” or “if only,” and right now, I’m ready to close the book before I even reach the final chapter."

recentItems.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern announcement trailer for this upcoming standalone management sim set within the fantasy universe of Dungeons & Dragons. The trailer gives a peek at gameplay, building, and more. In Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern, even legends need a long rest, so step into the underestimated but crucial role of innkeeper, build a cozy, ale-stocked abode for adventurers and help the land’s mightiest heroes prepare for their next great quest. Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern will be available on PC in 2027.

The Blood of Dawnwalker - Don't Skip These Important Prologue Quests
recentItems.description:
So you’re wondering how to spend your time before the dreaded Mass ceremony. In The Blood of Dawnwalker, time progresses when you complete activities and quests marked with an hourglass. There will also be a number next to it, indicating how many hours, or time segments, will be filled when completing that task. Here are the best quests to complete in the prologue before Mass.

00:53 - Live Bait
02:16 - Deep Down
03:33 - Withering Away
05:19 - Blasphemy
07:22 - On The Run
08:42 - Someone Needs a Lesson
09:30 - Bandit’s Treasure Map
10:23 - Disturbed
11:25 - Other Ways to Earn

recentItems.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker: Nighttime Open World Exploration
recentItems.description:
In this video, we're showcasing what life in The Blood of Dawnwalker looks like at night. When the sun goes down, vampiric powers take center stage, swapping swordplay for sharp claws, and movement abilities that make getting around then open world feel smooth. See how Coen feeds on prey to regain health and how the night progresses across open world activities.
